REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
PROPERTY PRESERVATION COMMISSION
TUESDAY - MAY 28, 2019 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
City Council Chamber
AGENDA MATERIALS: Staff reports are available for public inspection at the Cerritos Sheriff''s Station/Community Safety Center, 18135 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA
90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1203. Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to
the Property Preservation Commission after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the Cerritos Sheriff''s Station/Community Safety Center at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS: Public comments will be allowed on all Agenda items at the
time each matter comes up for discussion. The public comments portion of the
meeting will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five
minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of
appropriate responses, persons are requested to state their name and city of residence
for the record.

2.

5.

6.
Public Hearing Items
A.
A request submitted by the City of Cerritos, Community Safety Division, to the Property Preservation Commission for confirmation that the property located at 11546 Bos Street, Cerritos, California, 90703, has a lack of adequate ground cover, a lack of landscape maintenance, a vehicle parked on an unapproved area, and is in an unsightly condition which violates Section 6.20.040 of the Cerritos Municipal Code (APN 7039-028-026).
Property Preservation Commission Case No. PPC 2019-49
B.
A request submitted by the City of Cerritos, Community Safety Division, to the Property Preservation Commission for confirmation that the property located at 10757 Hedda Place, Cerritos, California, 90703, has structure exteriors in need of repair and paint and trash cans stored in public view which violates Section 6.20.040 of the Cerritos Municipal Code (APN 7038-002-025).
Property Preservation Commission Case No. PPC 2019-50
C.
A request submitted by the City of Cerritos, Community Safety Division, to the Property Preservation Commission for confirmation that the property located at 17103 Jeanette Avenue, Cerritos, California, 90703, has a lack of adequate ground cover, oil stains on the driveway, overgrown vegetation, and structure exteriors in need of repair and paint which violates Section 6.20.040 of the Cerritos Municipal Code (APN 7012-024-018).
Property Preservation Commission Case No. PPC 2019-51
D.
A request submitted by the City of Cerritos, Community Safety Division, to the Property Preservation Commission for confirmation that the property located at 13230 Sutton Street, Cerritos, California, 90703, has a lack of landscape maintenance, weeds, trash cans and debris stored in an area visible from the public street, a lack of adequate ground cover, overgrown vegetation, and dead vegetation which violates Section 6.20.040 of the Cerritos Municipal Code (APN 7027-018-007).
Property Preservation Commission Case No. PPC 2019-52
E.
A request submitted by the City of Cerritos, Community Safety Division, to the Property Preservation Commission for confirmation that the property located at 12239 Creekwood Avenue, Cerritos, California, 90703, has debris and trash cans stored in public view, an inoperable vehicle stored in public view, a vehicle parked on an unapproved area, a lack of adequate ground cover, structure exteriors in need of repair and paint, and a lack of landscape maintenance which violates Section 6.20.040 of the Cerritos Municipal Code (APN 7056-010-005).
Property Preservation Commission Case No. PPC 2019-53
F.
A request submitted by the City of Cerritos, Community Safety Division, to the Property Preservation Commission for confirmation that the property located at 19304 Kay Avenue, Cerritos, California, 90703, has structure exteriors in need of repair and paint and is in an unsightly condition which violates Section 6.20.040 of the Cerritos Municipal Code (APN 7044-009-033).
Property Preservation Commission Case No. PPC 2019-54
